headline: Bitcoin fell below $60,000 as Monday's Nvidia-driven bounce reversed, while traders now see a December Fed rate hike as close to certain ahead of Wednesday's US inflation data.

market.asOf: Bitcoin price and 24h change from CoinMarketCap, read at about 12:00 UTC Tue 24 Nov (19:00 Bangkok); CoinDesk put bitcoin near $59,900 at 11:31 UTC. Ether from CoinDesk (11:31 UTC) and Solana from Unchained (about 10:22 UTC); Solana's 24h change could not be confirmed. Use the live prices on this page.

stories.title: Bitcoin slips below $60,000 as the Nvidia bounce fades
stories.summary: Bitcoin has handed back the jump it made on Monday when Nvidia brought back Jensen Huang as CEO. Nvidia shares fell before the US open on Tuesday and bitcoin followed. Forced closing of leveraged bets roughly tripled, and money kept leaving US bitcoin funds.
points: Bitcoin dropped 2.2% since midnight UTC to around $59,900 by 11:31 UTC, per CoinDesk; its low was $59,380 on Bitstamp, almost 8% below the intraday high of $64,505, per CoinTurk.
Nvidia rose as much as 31% on Monday but was down 4.9% before Tuesday's US open, with Nasdaq 100 futures down about 1%, per CoinDesk.
$844 million of crypto futures bets were liquidated over 24 hours, up 217%, including $357 million on bitcoin and $176 million on ether, per CoinDesk.
US spot bitcoin funds lost $569.7 million on Monday 23 Nov, their fifth straight day of outflows, and about $4.71 billion so far in November, per Farside data cited by CoinDesk.
US spot ether funds lost $84.96 million on Monday, their seventh straight day of outflows, per SoSoValue data cited by TokenPost.

stories.title: A December Fed rate hike is now close to fully priced; inflation data lands Wednesday
stories.summary: Markets now treat a Federal Reserve rate rise at the 8-9 December meeting as all but certain, after New York Fed President John Williams said the Fed must act to bring inflation back to 2%. Higher rates tend to weigh on risky assets like crypto. Wednesday's October PCE inflation report is the next big test.
points: CME FedWatch showed a 97.8% chance of a quarter-point hike in December and 2.2% for a half-point hike, per FXEmpire (24 Nov); a day earlier the figure was 96.1%, per Longbridge.
Williams said: "We must take actions over time that will ensure that we get inflation back to our 2% goal in a timely manner", per Trading and Investment News.
October PCE prices are expected to rise 0.3% on the month after 0.5% in September, per Binance News via TradingView.
PCE, the second estimate of Q3 GDP, durable goods and jobless claims all come out Wed 25 Nov at 8:30am ET (20:30 Bangkok); see the calendar below.
US stock markets are closed on Thursday 26 Nov for Thanksgiving, per ICE's holiday calendar.

stories.title: South Korea publishes its draft crypto law
stories.summary: South Korea's Financial Services Commission released a draft digital asset law on Tuesday, a broad rulebook for the country's crypto industry. It would put banks in control of won stablecoins, cap how much of an exchange one big owner can hold and allow token sales with a filed white paper. It still has to pass the National Assembly.
points: Banks must collectively own more than 50% of any won stablecoin issuer, which must hold 100% reserves and cannot pay interest, per CoinDesk.
A single major shareholder of an exchange would be capped at 20%, which the regulator can raise to 34%; existing exchanges get three years to comply, per The Block.
Domestic token offerings would be allowed if the issuer files a white paper with the regulator first, per The Block.
Offshore stablecoins such as USDT could circulate if they meet the regulator's standards, per The Block.

briefs.title: US moves to seize over $1.1 billion in USDC from the Binance hack
briefs.summary: The Justice Department is seeking more than $1.1 billion in frozen USDC from the 29 Oct Binance hack; about $2.35 billion is still in wallets linked to the theft and at least $247 million has gone through mixers, per Elliptic data cited by CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Sky's stUSDS lending pool runs dry
briefs.summary: Sky's roughly $159 million stUSDS pool hit 99.99% use, leaving nothing to withdraw; cofounder Rune Christensen may sell SKY to repay about 77 million USDS of loans, and three major Korean exchanges paused SKY/USDS deposits, per The Block.

briefs.title: Monad's large MON unlock is today
briefs.summary: About 16.61 billion MON unlock on 24 Nov per CryptoRank, or 17.105 billion per DefiLlama, per Coinranking. See the unlock table on this page for this desk's figure and confidence.

briefs.title: Strategy bought 457 more bitcoin
briefs.summary: Strategy bought 457 BTC last week for about $29.6 million and now holds 851,305 BTC, funded by sales of its common stock, per The Block.

briefs.title: Strategy and Metaplanet leave MSCI indexes on 30 Nov
briefs.summary: Strategy leaves the MSCI USA Index and Metaplanet the MSCI Japan Small Cap Index at the close on 30 Nov, per The Block.

briefs.title: Ethereum Foundation doubles its security team
briefs.summary: The Ethereum Foundation doubled its protocol security team and called AI a "more urgent risk" than quantum computing, per The Block.

briefs.title: Court ends TerraUSD lawsuit against Coinbase
briefs.summary: A California court dismissed a proposed class action against Coinbase over TerraUSD (UST) purchases, per The Block.

briefs.title: Kalshi pauses in Utah
briefs.summary: Prediction market Kalshi paused operations in Utah while it waits for a court ruling, per The Block; a New York judge declined to block it there.
